The main takeaway from our work is that
the stable isotopic compositions of fossil corals from shallow water environments can be used to study the paleoceanographic and paleoclimatic conditions of the past.
coral stable isotopic data are a powerful tool to reconstruct the paleoceanographic history of the Red Sea, especially when used in combination with other paleoarchives.
